user_question: Can you provide a summary of the key information in this document?
answer: This is an Affidavit of Performance sworn by Holly Inzer, Bookkeeper of the New Albany Tribune newspaper, certifying that an insert advertisement for Harley Davidson Cigarettes was published on January 31, 1988. The document was prepared for Lorillard Media Service (the advertising agency) and was notarized on March 4, 1988 in Floyd County, Indiana. The affidavit confirms that the charges billed were correct and that the advertisement was exclusive to the New Albany Tribune. The notary's commission was set to expire on February 9, 1990.
